content:
Olga (oncall): hitting a big latency spike across eu-dedicated pools, 99p went from 120ms -> 1.8s around 11:10UTC :rotating_light:
Matt (eng-sre): saw that alert. saturation counter on pool-eu-3 went from 0.3 -> 0.95, lots of evictions logged.
Alice (eng-runtime): initial profiler shows kernel_choice fallback on many requests: selected kernel=generic_fp32 instead of optimized_amp due to memory pressure. KV cache miss rate jumped to 47%.
Raj (eng-infra): checking placement logs — quota allocator moved three mid-tier tenants into pool-eu-3 at 11:06 because their reservation ttl expired. quota config for eu-reserved missed the min-isolation flag.
Sophia (eng-platform): so we have placement + quota miscalc + noisy tenant landing on same pool. that makes sense.
Matt (eng-sre): can we confirm batch sizes? if runtime saw many small batches that'll hurt throughput.
Alice (eng-runtime): yes, batching heuristics degenerated: continuous-batcher window shrank from 6ms -> 1ms under high tail submit rates. effective batch size dropped 8x.
Olga (oncall): posting the quick logs:
```
[11:09:58] pool-eu-3: eviction start tenant=tenant-42 reason=slot_pressure
[11:10:02] runtime: kernel_select: preferred=optimized_amp, chosen=generic_fp32, reason=kv_pages_unavailable
[11:10:05] batcher: window=1ms, avg_batch=2, tokens/s=120
[11:10:12] allocator: placed tenant-77 -> pool-eu-3 (from eu-reserved) ttl-expire
```
Matt (eng-sre): :eyes: eviction ripple likely caused cache pressure which caused kernel choice to fallback. any coroners on noisy neighbor?
Alice (eng-runtime): yes, tenant-77 has high openai-style long-context chat workload, lots of KV warmups. Its KV working set spilled, triggering cache thrash and dropped prefix-cache hit ratio.
Raj (eng-infra): quota config bug: eu-reserved policy accidentally had "allow_overcommit": true for the MID tier after the last deploy. deploy-bot rolled the policy at 11:05.
deply-bot: deploy confirmed: config-eu/quota-policy v2.3 -> v2.4 by @sophia (this line is synthetic)
Sophia (eng-platform): that was me — I merged a permissive change to support quick bursts. didn't think about isolation. my bad.
Olga (oncall): action plan now?
Matt (eng-sre): immediate: revert quota-policy to v2.3 (prevent new placements), cordon pool-eu-3 for new placements, and increase batcher window temporarily.
Alice (eng-runtime): can push runtime hotfix: force kernel blacklisting of generic_fp32 for high-priority models on dedicated pools, and bump kv-cache low-water mark to reduce thrash. command to run:
```
rictl runtime update --node pool-eu-3 --set batcher.window_ms=6 --set kv.low_water_pct=0.25 --blacklist-kernel generic_fp32
```
Raj (eng-infra): I'll revert quota and cordon the pool. running: `rictl quota apply config-eu/quota-policy@v2.3` and `rictl pool cordon pool-eu-3`.
Sophia (eng-platform): i'm rolling back my PR and will follow up with a test that catches "isolation=false" for reserved pools.
Olga (oncall): doing quick perf check after fixes.
[~7 minutes later]
Olga (oncall): after cordon + runtime bump: 99p dropped to 210ms, avg batch size back to 10, kv miss down to 12%. eviction rate stopped. :thumbsup:
Alice (eng-runtime): running a detailed profile for root cause and to prevent regression. profiler command:
```
rictl profile --target pool-eu-3 --duration 120s --tags kernel_choice,batching,kv_cache > /tmp/pool-eu-3-profile.log
```
Matt (eng-sre): good. also let's create a postmortem and include the trace snippets and the config diff. I'm adding an initial timeline.
Sophia (eng-platform): adding automated check to CI: reserved pool quota changes require explicit "isolation: true" and an approval step. will add a lint rule.
Raj (eng-infra): follow-up infra work: add pressure-aware placement heuristics so we don't shove mid-tier into same pool if slot_util > 0.7.
Alice (eng-runtime): runtime follow-ups: make batching window adaptive with a floor (>=4ms) and add KV eviction smoothing to avoid thrash during transient spikes.
Olga (oncall): assigning owners: Sophia -> quota-policy revert + CI lint, Raj -> pool placement heuristic, Alice -> runtime hotfix + profile analysis, Matt -> postmortem and SLA impact calc.
Sophia (eng-platform): noted. creating PRs and will ping for reviews.
Olga (oncall): closing incident channel here, moving to postmortems for write-up. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
